anchors.meaning: Functional but visibly incomplete or inconsistent.
Solid baseline indie quality with material shortcomings.
Cohesive premium release quality for the intended audience.
Distinctive, highly polished, and class-leading for its scope.

dimensions.name: Core control feel and readability
criteria: Movement is predictable, responsive, and expressive.
Damage, hazards, goals, and enemy intentions are readable.
Difficulty failures feel attributable to player decisions rather than ambiguity.

dimensions.name: World and stage differentiation
criteria: Worlds introduce materially different mechanics and decisions.
Enemy behavior and encounter composition vary meaningfully.
Boss progression expresses the world's identity rather than reusing one fight.

dimensions.name: Content value, pacing, and replayability
criteria: The opening, learning curve, escalation, secrets, and ending form a coherent arc.
Campaign length and authored variety justify the planned price.
Optional goals and routes add meaningful replay value without padding.

dimensions.name: Visual, animation, and audio cohesion
criteria: Backgrounds, characters, effects, UI, and animation share a coherent art direction.
Music and sound reinforce world identity, action, and feedback.
No placeholder, permanently retained, missing, or visibly incompatible asset remains.

dimensions.name: Onboarding, narrative, and product identity
criteria: The premise, player goal, controls, and stakes are clear without external explanation.
The product has a memorable identity distinct from its references.
Store-facing names and claims match the shipped experience.

dimensions.name: Stability, performance, and save integrity
criteria: Representative sessions complete without crash, soft lock, leak, or progression loss.
Frame pacing, loading, input processing, and asset delivery remain acceptable on the target class of hardware.
Save validation and migration preserve bounded, legitimate progress.

dimensions.name: Accessibility and input coverage
criteria: Keyboard, gamepad, and touch behavior are usable where claimed.
Reduced motion, reduced flash, volume, pause, and readable UI settings work in practice.
Critical information is not conveyed by a single inaccessible cue.

dimensions.name: Commercial, IP, and asset readiness
criteria: Product identity avoids unlicensed or confusing third-party names and presentation.
Every shipped asset has a traceable commercial-use basis.
Required attribution, notices, price claims, and store disclosures are complete.
